name: Arlington County, VA
findings: Arlington County has 1,384 nonprofit organizations. 674 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 588 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Arlington County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Arlington County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 62 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
